a_motion: Smooth diagonal camera pan and tilt rotating around the yellow Recurly card.
Subtle shifting of soft shadows across the card crevices.
Dynamic depth-of-field shift keeping the main card sharp while background elements blur.
b_motion: Linear, mechanical camera translation along a rigid path.
Static, flat lighting with no visible shadow travel or depth-of-field changes.
absent_in_b: Soft contact shadows/ambient occlusion under the cards.
Shallow depth-of-field blur on background elements.

differences.a_does: Uses soft global illumination with realistic ambient occlusion and subtle specular highlights on matte card surfaces.
differences.b_does: Renders with flat, uniform lighting and basic diffuse shaders, making the 3D cards look like flat 2D shapes.
differences.fix: Enable ambient occlusion, add a soft key light with a large radius, and add a subtle specular gloss to the card materials.

differences.a_does: Applies a shallow depth of field to naturally blur background cards and focus attention on the Recurly card.
differences.b_does: Keeps the entire scene in sharp focus, flattening the composition.
differences.fix: Enable camera depth of field, set focus to the yellow card, and adjust the aperture to blur background elements.

differences.a_does: Executes a smooth, sweeping camera path with organic ease-in/ease-out curves.
differences.b_does: Moves the camera on a rigid, linear path with abrupt starts and stops.
differences.fix: Adjust camera keyframe interpolation in the graph editor to use smooth bezier curves with generous easing.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Upgrade the lighting and materials by adding ambient occlusion and soft specular highlights to restore the tactile 3D quality of the cards.

Static, uniform drop shadows remain unchanged.
No specular response or material texture animation.
absent_in_b: Beveled keycap geometry and tight keyboard layout.

differences.b_does: Flat, widely spaced rectangular panels floating over a plain background.

differences.a_does: Soft, diffused lighting with realistic contact shadows and edge speculars.
differences.b_does: Flat lighting with a harsh, artificial dark inset border around the yellow button.
differences.fix: Remove the dark inset border, soften shadows, and add specular highlights to bevels.

differences.a_does: Low-angle perspective emphasizing 3D depth and volume.
differences.b_does: Steep, top-down angle that flattens the composition.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Rebuild the keycap geometry and layout to eliminate the flat, widely spaced panel look.

Subtle shift of soft specular highlights across the matte yellow card.

differences.a_does: Tight, low-angle close-up with strong shallow depth of field focusing on the yellow card.
differences.b_does: Wide, high-angle shot with flat perspective and no depth of field, keeping everything sharp.
differences.fix: Increase camera focal length to ~85mm, move closer to the yellow card, lower the pitch angle, and enable depth of field.

differences.a_does: Soft, diffused directional lighting with realistic shadow falloff and ambient occlusion.
differences.b_does: Harsh, sharp-edged shadows with no soft penumbra, making the scene look flat and artificial.
differences.fix: Increase the physical size of the primary light source to soften shadow edges and enable ambient occlusion.

differences.a_does: Clean, seamless 3D bevel on the yellow card defined purely by soft lighting.
differences.b_does: Yellow card has a harsh, dark grey outline/stroke effect along its edges.
differences.fix: Remove the dark outline stroke from the card geometry and rely on soft specular highlights to define the bevel.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera focal length and position to match the tight, shallow depth-of-field close-up of the yellow card, and soften the directional light source to eliminate the harsh, sharp shadows.

agreed_differences.a_does: Uses soft, diffused lighting with realistic ambient occlusion and subtle specular highlights.
agreed_differences.b_does: Renders with flat, uniform lighting and harsh, sharp-edged shadows.
agreed_differences.fix: Enable ambient occlusion, increase the light source size to soften shadow edges, and add subtle specular highlights to the card surfaces.
